preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership through transferOwnership)

exploit_hint: As owner, call setMarketingWallet() to set the marketing wallet to attacker's address. Then trigger the swapAndLiquify mechanism by transferring tokens to create contract balance, which will send ETH to the marketing wallet. Alternatively, exclude attacker from fees and transfer large amounts without paying taxes, or set maxTxAmount to zero to block all transfers.
